summary: Magnitude International Ltd, a Singapore-based M&E electrical works provider, furnished a Form 6-K disclosing an additional Nasdaq staff determination dated September 16, 2026, citing non-compliance with Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) for failure to timely file its FY2026 Form 20-F, layered atop an August 3, 2026 discretionary delisting determination under IM-5101-4 concerning potential third-party misconduct. The company filed the Form 20-F on September 17, 2026, and Nasdaq confirmed same-day compliance, closing the filing deficiency. Watch whether the IM-5101-4 misconduct determination remains unresolved, the primary lingering delisting risk and arb catalyst.
